fields.name: padding
fields.label: Padding
fields.hint: Adds a margin during this stage.

fields.name: remove_background
fields.label: Remove Background
fields.hint: Segments the subject for the TRELLIS.2 passes. Pixal3D prepares its own first-pass reference.

fields.name: geometry_backend
fields.label: Geometry generator
fields.hint: Selects the first mesh generator. QuadDC, TRELLIS.2 mesh refinement and material generation follow either choice.

fields.name: modelname
fields.label: TRELLIS.2 model family
fields.hint: Uses the local TRELLIS.2 GGUF checkpoint for refinement and texturing, and for the first pass when TRELLIS.2 GGUF is selected.

fields.name: model_format
fields.label: Weight format
fields.hint: Uses the installed Q4_K_M weights. Other formats require a compatible installed model.

fields.name: device
fields.label: Compute device
fields.hint: The reconstruction and texture stages use CUDA.

fields.name: backend
fields.label: Attention backend
fields.hint: Controls the attention implementation. xFormers is the validated backend for both dense and sparse attention.

fields.name: low_vram
fields.label: Low VRAM
fields.hint: Moves models between CPU and GPU to reduce peak graphics memory.

fields.name: keep_models_loaded
fields.label: Keep weights loaded
fields.hint: Keeps the weights loaded between stages of the same job.

fields.name: seed
fields.label: Seed
fields.hint: Controls random sampling in this stage. Keep it fixed when comparing another setting.

fields.name: sparse_structure_steps
fields.label: Sparse Structure Steps
fields.hint: Sets the number of sampling steps in this stage.

fields.name: sparse_structure_guidance_strength
fields.label: Sparse Structure Guidance Strength
fields.hint: Controls how strongly sampling follows the reference.

fields.name: sparse_structure_guidance_rescale
fields.label: Sparse Structure Guidance Rescale
fields.hint: Adjusts guidance amplitude at a high guidance strength.

fields.name: sparse_structure_rescale_t
fields.label: Sparse Structure Rescale T
fields.hint: Redistributes diffusion timesteps across the sampling pass.

fields.name: shape_steps
fields.label: Shape Steps
fields.hint: Sets the number of sampling steps in this stage.

fields.name: shape_guidance_strength
fields.label: Shape Guidance Strength
fields.hint: Controls how strongly sampling follows the reference.

fields.name: shape_guidance_rescale
fields.label: Shape Guidance Rescale
fields.hint: Adjusts guidance amplitude at a high guidance strength.

fields.name: shape_rescale_t
fields.label: Shape Rescale T
fields.hint: Redistributes diffusion timesteps across the sampling pass.

fields.name: texture_steps
fields.label: Texture Steps
fields.hint: This latent is discarded before mesh export. The final texture pass has its own settings.

fields.name: texture_guidance_strength
fields.label: Texture Guidance Strength
fields.hint: This latent is discarded before mesh export. The final texture pass has its own settings.

fields.name: texture_guidance_rescale
fields.label: Texture Guidance Rescale
fields.hint: This latent is discarded before mesh export. The final texture pass has its own settings.

fields.name: texture_rescale_t
fields.label: Texture Rescale T
fields.hint: This latent is discarded before mesh export. The final texture pass has its own settings.

fields.name: max_num_tokens
fields.label: Max Num Tokens
fields.hint: Sets the token budget for sampling the sparse representation.

fields.name: max_views
fields.label: Maximum reference views
fields.hint: This workflow accepts one reference image.

fields.name: generate_texture_slat
fields.label: Generate material latent
fields.hint: This latent is discarded before mesh export. The final texture pass has its own settings.

fields.name: sparse_structure_guidance_interval_start
fields.label: Sparse Structure Guidance Interval Start
fields.hint: Normalized start of the interval during which guidance is applied.

fields.name: sparse_structure_guidance_interval_end
fields.label: Sparse Structure Guidance Interval End
fields.hint: Normalized end of the interval during which guidance is applied.

fields.name: shape_guidance_interval_start
fields.label: Shape Guidance Interval Start
fields.hint: Normalized start of the interval during which guidance is applied.

fields.label: Shape Guidance Interval End

fields.name: texture_guidance_interval_end
fields.label: Texture Guidance Interval End
fields.hint: This latent is discarded before mesh export. The final texture pass has its own settings.

fields.name: sparse_structure_postprocessing
fields.label: Sparse structure postprocessing
fields.hint: Runs optional occupancy-grid repair before sampling the shape.

fields.name: fill_holes
fields.label: Fill Holes
fields.hint: Fills gaps in the first-pass occupancy grid when sparse structure postprocessing is enabled.

fields.name: hole_iterations
fields.label: Hole Iterations
fields.hint: Controls the number of closing or flood-fill passes in the sparse grid.

fields.name: verbose
fields.label: Verbose
fields.hint: Adds sampling and mesh details to the generation log.

fields.name: sparse_hole_size
fields.label: Sparse hole size
fields.hint: Sets the closing kernel or small-hole threshold in the occupancy grid.

fields.name: dino_lock
fields.label: DINO lock
fields.hint: Blends toward the image-conditioned shape or material during denoising. Zero uses the selected base solver.

fields.name: dino_substeps
fields.label: DINO substeps
fields.hint: Subdivides each sampling interval when DINO lock is active.

fields.name: hole_fill_algorithm
fields.label: Hole Fill Algorithm
fields.hint: Selects the sparse-grid repair method used before shape sampling.

fields.name: dino_foundation_cap
fields.label: DINO foundation cap
fields.hint: Controls how long the reference blend remains active during the DINO lock schedule.

fields.name: keep_only_shell
fields.label: Keep Only Shell
fields.hint: Removes deep interior occupancy when sparse structure postprocessing is enabled.

fields.name: remesh_band
fields.label: Remesh band
fields.hint: Sets the width of the QuadDC reconstruction band in voxels.

fields.name: remove_floaters
fields.label: Remove Floaters
fields.hint: Removes small disconnected components after reconstruction.

fields.name: remove_inner_faces
fields.label: Remove Inner Faces
fields.hint: Drops duplicate interior faces from the reconstructed surface.
